name: How long does an accessibility remodeling project usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does an accessibility remodeling project usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Project duration for accessibility remodeling depends on the complexity and extent of the modifications. Simple updates like grab bar installation might take a day, while a bathroom or kitchen remodel for full accessibility can take several weeks. Projects involving structural changes or extensive custom work will naturally require more time. We provide a timeline estimate after assessing your specific project requirements.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; simple updates may take a day, while extensive remodels can last several weeks, depending on complexity.
